messages:
lia: quick poll — we need a final decision on OTEL span naming + semantic attrs for LLM requests. posting a compact proposal. please react or comment by EOD.
lia: proposed minimal span shape (suggested defaults):
```
span.name = 'llm.request'
span.kind = 'server'
attributes:
  redwood.op = 'generate' | 'embed' | 'rerank'
  redwood.model.name = 'gpt-x/7b'
  redwood.model.version = 'v1.2'
  redwood.model.quant = 'q4_0'  # optional
  redwood.tokens.total = 123
  redwood.tokens.prompt = 90
  redwood.tokens.completion = 33
  redwood.kvcache.hit = true / false
  redwood.batch.size = 4
  redwood.routing.policy = 'latency' | 'cost'
  redwood.sensitive = false  # used by exporters to redact
```
arjun: +1 on capturing tokens split. question: span.name should be verb-y like `llm.generate`? easier to filter for generation latency in dashboards.
perry: prefer a single stable root (`llm.request`) + `redwood.op` to avoid explosion of span names across ops. dashboards can pivot on `redwood.op`.
jess: add `redwood.model.quant` and `redwood.model.size_gb`. also recommend `redwood.model.variant` for distros (e.g., 'fp16', 'int8').
michael: add `redwood.kvcache.prefetch=true/false` and `redwood.kvcache.size_bytes`. for batching, capture `redwood.batch.input_count` and `redwood.batch.tokens_total`.
lia: good feedback. decision proposal: root span = `llm.request`; include `redwood.op` (generate|embed|rerank) and a set of nullable attributes developers can send. keep `span.name` constant for stable traces & rate-based dashboards.
arjun: ok if we keep `llm.request` then please ensure we set `redwood.op` as an indexed tag in exporters (we need fast queries on op). also set `span.status` mapping for quota/fallbacks.
perry: exporters/retention note — do NOT include raw prompt text. instead use `redwood.prompt_id` (sha256) and `redwood.prompt_length`. flagged as sensitive if prompting contains PII: `redwood.sensitive=true`.
jess: agree. also capture `redwood.model.quant` and `redwood.model.checksum` for reproducibility.
lia: retention/exporter defaults proposal: prod spans -> OTLP/gRPC to observability cluster, retention 90d; debug spans -> 7d. spans with `redwood.sensitive=true` get redaction pipeline and shorter retention unless requested. filing ops ticket for exceptions.
michael: small API ask — let SDKs accept `tokens.prompt`/`tokens.completion` or compute both if only total+prompt given. avoid client-side duplication.
lia: noted. i'll draft PR for the telemetry spec and SDK helpers. will include examples for node/python.
notel-bot: created telemetry/issue#812: "llm span attr spec + retention defaults" (https://git.internal/r/telemetry/812).
lia: thanks — assigning to @arjun and @jess for review, will ping eng-sre for exporter tweak. :thumbsup:
